difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the module of global sections of the sheaf of relative differentials over an affine chart with the algebra module of differentials of the corresponding ring map, compatibly with the two derivations (statement lines 6657-6666). The counted proof reduces to the affine case by restriction of differentials and then compares two representable functors through two explicitly written arrows, alpha from the linear maps of the module of global sections to the derivations and beta constructed from the identifications of sheaf derivations and module derivations, checks that they are mutually inverse on global sections, and concludes by the universal property together with Yoneda's lemma (proof lines 6668-6702). It is H2: the argument is a complete functorial comparison carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the universal property and Yoneda's lemma.
